messages.text: Parcera, I left you 5 audios from the 580 because my thumbs were useless. Start with the second one, first is just cafecito chaos.
Listening after I park. Also found the teal blanket you liked, washed it yesterday.
Que nota. If I come up Friday after my last home visit, I am claiming that blanket and the left side of the couch.
Key will be under the clay pot if I am still at campus. Send ETA by audio, not the freeway novel.
Mija, encontré mi chaqueta azul de la clínica en el garage. Three Marches already since I stopped those Friday shifts, can you believe it?
Keep it for the memory box. The tiny dinosaur badge reel deserves museum treatment.
Ay, those little patients loved that dinosaur. Also call your brother tonight if you can; his 4pm Dr. K call got moved and he sounded wound up.
I will. And please don't let Dad forward the body-cam article to the Fresno thread before lunch.
Mija, encontré el libro azul que dejaste en el sofá. Tiene un papelito en una página que dice 'recursion of choice?'
Ah yes, please keep that bookmark in. I need the last Chiang piece for the sketch notes before Friday.
También vi tus punticos negros dibujados al lado, como semillas. Muy ordenaditos.
Those are for the wall pattern test. Tiny repeated dots look different after the scene shifts.
Do you want to still do dinner call at 7? I am making rasam and rice, very low ambition.
Yes. I have the Sunday lentil pot and the orange tray veg, so I can pretend I made a real plate.
A real plate is a real plate. Please tell me you did not do the toast plus coffee thing until 5 again.
Only until 2:30, which is practically growth. Heating lentils now before you audit me.
Do you still have the photo of me looking sleep-deprived at that tiny Chico arrivals curb? I want it for the badly-captioned travel folder.
The one where you're holding the Oakland boarding pass and judging my parking job? Yes.
Perfect. Also the Sunday flower field one if it exists. I remember being covered in red dirt by noon.
I'll dig through October photos after dinner. That whole weekend has its own weird little album.
I got through the draft while the rasam simmered. The generated page layouts are beautiful, but your ablation table needs one more baseline before the committee asks.
Yeah, Camila trained the text-to-image sampler on A100s overnight and the visual-poem metrics shifted again. I’m rerunning the stats in R after dinner.
Send me the CSV after the R pass. Also your Research.gov paragraph says the student slot starts 6/1 but the budget sheet says 7/1.
Good catch. I’ll fix the 6/1 line before I route it to OSP tomorrow morning.
Parcera, I sent you that reel of the ceramic printer thing. Did it get buried?
Saw it right before my little photo-app timer shut me out. Saving it for tomorrow morning.
jajaja discipline. Meanwhile the purple place is yelling about mesh glitches again?
Two channels at once: render critique in one, Spanish-English methodology thread in the other. I closed the reel and went there instead.
Mija, how is your arm this morning? Did they give you the little paper for your records?
Sore but fine. Paper is in the passport folder with the yellow booklet from the travel clinic.
Bueno. Take a photo also, because you lose papers when you travel.
Already scanned it before coffee. You trained me too well.
Mija, Rafael dice que si vienes por la 99 traigas los envases grandes, los dejaste aqui despues del almuerzo.
Los tengo apuntados. Tambien voy a llevar la bolsa termica para que no se derrame el aji en el Outback otra vez.
Ay no, pobre carro. Y dime si quieres arroz con coco o yuca, porque voy a empezar la lista.
Yuca, please. I will confirm once I check the Sunday block on my calendar.
Mija, did you finish the March computer thing you said Intuit was making you do? I found the folder from last year if you need it.
Almost. I am missing one 1098-E PDF from the federal portal, then TurboTax stops yelling at me.
Bueno. And don't forget the $180 one that comes out next week, I saw you write it on the fridge calendar when you were here.
Yep, leaving that on autopay. The rate is tiny, so I am not moving extra grocery money there.
Maya says the narwhal needs the 'big TV pen thing' again Saturday, not the iPad.
Tell her the big TV pen thing is charging. $800 rectangle is earning its keep.
Also she wants the background to do the moving-shape thing from your last post.
I can run that patch while we sketch. It exported cleaner lines on the Cintiq than the old setup.
Upper Park is muddy, so I moved Saturday to Table Mountain. Also, saw a Carmen birthday reminder pop up on your shared calendar when you screenshotted the trail map.
Oops, old calendar category. That's Daniel's mom. I still send her a quick birthday note.
Got it. Want me to pretend I did not see Daniel's name in the color-coding too?
Please. That calendar survived too many paperwork rounds in 2024.
Hooker Oak form opened. Want me to put you back in midfield for the June-August Tuesday nights?
Yes, please. Same spot is fine, but no 9pm starts if we can avoid it.
Noted. Also I refuse to schedule us against purple-beam night if that Sac game stays at 7:30.
Correct priorities. My shins can wait; that fourth quarter cannot.
Parcera I need the post-show report. Did Ben actually save you a chair or was it all mysterious guitar boy energy?
He saved the end stool by the sound board. I brought him the ginger candies because his voice was rough after rehearsal.
Mmm okay, points for practical throat-care romance without being corny.
We grabbed tacos after and he remembered the exact story from January about the broken kiln, which was annoying in a charming way.
Priya wants to know what bottle to bring Sunday. Something red but not the grocery-store jammy stuff, right?
Tempranillo if she sees a natural one. Old-vine garnacha also works. One bottle is plenty; I am keeping this week to the Friday glass plus Sunday dinner.
Got it. Also your tiny silver pen thing is still in the guest-room basket from Thanksgiving. Do you want it back?
Yeah, just toss it in the side pocket of Maya's art bag. It is probably still half full.
Upper Park Saturday? 8:10 at the usual lot if the rain holds.
Can do a shorter loop. I promised Linh I'd send the ablation table before dinner and Sunday may get eaten by the rebuttal.
Short loop it is. Bring trail shoes and your laptop guilt can stay in the car.
Deal. I was off campus today finishing notes from yesterday's check-ins, so my legs need actual dirt.
Mija, did yesterday's call with Dr. Patel finish before your class prep?
Yes, barely. Paid the $40 right after so I wouldn't forget.
Bueno. And tonight try the tea before bed, no laptop in bed, por favor ❤️
I know, I know. The 50 mg tablet is helping overall; it's just making bedtime lighter than usual.
Did you ever figure out whether your job match is still 4%? Mine changed again and the portal is a maze.
Yeah, mine still shows 4%. Same page has the $2,000 conference line, so I screenshot it before payroll eats my patience.
Good. Also check the paycheck math after you move that pre-tax card amount. Those $180-ish deductions sneak by.
Already on it. I want the March load high enough for Dr. Patel and the frames without messing up summer travel cash.
I marked two paragraphs in the diffusion draft. The campus compute section reads like you are trying not to offend the cluster gods.
Accurate. I have a 9am slot Monday to beg for more GPU hours before the narrative evals choke again.
Also your benefits screenshot made me mad. Same hallway, same grants, but the CFA checkbox is still grayed out?
Yep. Kendra said the RA line keeps me outside it, even with the 94,000 field sitting right there in the portal.
Did you grab the Denver room before the block evaporated?
Yep. Flight + hotel + badge are in Concur now. I think my card only eats about $390 after the lab piece comes back.
Good. Save every tiny airport receipt, especially if this is one of your two big work trips this cycle.
Already made a folder. I am being aggressively boring about PDFs.
Mija, si te raspa la garganta, tengo panela nueva y limones del arbol de tu tia. Te guardo un paquete para el ultimo domingo.
Perfecto. I used the last block this morning and wrote before opening the news, so I am already less scrambled.
Bien. Escribe tambien tres cositas lindas, aunque sean pequenas. Eso ayuda a poner el corazon en orden.
Today was warm mug, Oliver sleeping on my ankle, and your cilantro photo. Very highbrow literature.
Still on for Tuesday sambar? Also: do you want me to bring that ginger-tulsi tea again, or is that too late in the day?
Bring it, but I’ll make it decaf after lunch. Learned my lesson from Thursday: jaw clamp by 4, then the ribcage squeeze drama.
Decaf it is. Please do the shoulder release thing before you start diagnosing yourself through Google again.
Fair. I did the 4-count breathing and it backed off. The inhaler stayed in the drawer, for once.
I put comments on the methods section. The ablation table still reads like two different projects got stitched together.
Accurate. I am trying to make this one less chaotic than the four CV entries from 2025.
Also your NeurIPS pile: do the borderlines first before you get emotionally attached to anyone's weak baselines.
Tonight is two sections of ours, then three score boxes. Dinner call may include keyboard noises.
Upper Park group is meeting at 8:30. You walking from your side or want a pickup by the little bungalows?
Walking. If I leave the Avenues by 8:18 I can hit the gate right on time.
Perfect. Also your block is wild in spring, every tree trying to outdo the next one.
And half the porches have bikes stacked four deep. March move-out energy already.
Upper Park is muddy but doable. You still coming, or did Jamal claim your whole weekend with the tiny wires again?
Coming for the short loop. I promised him I would not touch the soldering iron until after tacos.
Good. Marcus said his studio door will be open after noon if you two need a table that isn't covered in trail maps.
Perfect. I'll bring the little board and the battery pack in my daypack.
Upper Park loop tomorrow? I promise no weird loose-rock shortcut like last May.
Bless you. My calendar still has that whole boot-and-elevate week color-coded next to the July couch week.
Good. We keep you upright, then tacos. Also your 2025 spreadsheet really only has those two blank work chunks?
Yep, 10 weekdays total. Apparently I am very boring about showing up.
Upper Park was muddy but worth it. Are you still heading to Park Ave after tacos?
Yeah, I left the primed boards there. Need a few hours before the 2 pm route-map call.
Send me the storefront list after? I can sanity-check the downtown block order before Monday.
Will do. Also remind me to grab my jar from Mei's shelf before I leave.
Post-hike Naked or Chuy? I can keep eyes on the bikes if we do coffee first.
Coffee first. I used the last of the beans this morning after cup two, and I am not emotionally prepared for grocery-store backup.
Copy. Same rack by the window, but double locks this time.
Window rack only. I still side-eye that pole by the alley.
Upper Park crew is splitting after the hike. Coffee people are going Naked Lounge, hungry people are drifting toward Chuy.
I am firmly in the hungry lane. I already have this week's receipt category open from the grocery run.
Perfect. I'll walk over after I drop the sign-in sheet at my car.
Ordering at 12:20-ish. If I stay under 14 today the March food tab still looks civilized.
AQI app is already being dramatic for tomorrow. Upper Park might be dusty plus that north wind.
Yeah, I am packing the gray P100 and the little blue canister just in case. If it looks ugly by 7, I am voting coffee instead.
Deal. Also run your apartment box tonight, please. Last September you scared me with that five-day couch situation.
Already on high. It sounds like a tiny jet engine but at least the bedroom air feels normal.
Upper Park loop tomorrow? If we start at 7:45 we can get past the dusty stretch before bikes take over.
Tomorrow 8:20 at Horseshoe Lake lot. I moved us off Yahi because the mud is still dumb.
Perfect. I did the One-Mile loop this morning so my calves may file a complaint.
Yes. I want the long ridge version, no earbuds. I keep thinking about that quiet spot above the creek.
Deal. Also, are your legs okay after your 6:30 thing at Roots this week or am I setting a mercy pace?
Bring the poles then. Also you still owe me coffee after, Bidwell Perk side?
Deal. I’ll put the poles by the door tonight so I don’t leave them like last time.
Set a real pace. The early mat work actually makes the first climb feel cleaner.
Mija, si haces el pollo con arroz hoy, guarda una tacita del caldo primero. Te queda mas suave.
Good call. I already put toast in the toaster because I opened the repo before breakfast, so I need supervision.
Cafe no cuenta como desayuno. Mandame foto cuando pongas el arroz.
Deal. Chicken is thawing, peppers are going on the pan, and I will send proof before noon.
Did the tablet arrive or are you still pretending the old one isn't held together by vibes?
Arrived. Beautiful, rude, and the reason February closed at 4100 instead of feeling normal.
Worth it if Maya gets better dragon drawings. Also set aside the car 280 before you forget.
Already on the 13th. I'm trying to keep March boring: rent, groceries, studio, no shiny screens.
Are we still doing Tuesday sambar, or did your plant handoff turn into a whole hallway committee meeting?
Still on. Denise inspected the basil like a nurse and Ray asked whether Pixel gets the tiny spoon or the big spoon at 6.
Please tell me you labeled the spoons after last time.
Blue tape everywhere. Plant shelf, food bin, even the cabinet Pixel opens when she wants drama.
Mija, the aji amarillo peppers are finally turning orange. I can bring you some Sunday if you are making those little pork arepas again.
Yes please. Priya wants the filling less smoky this time, so I am testing one pan tonight and saving notes.
Send me a picture when they puff. Use the blue plate, it looked pretty last time.
I will. The window light is better before 6, so I am trying to finish the first batch early.
Mija, your dad found the envelope from Dec. 24 in the glove box. It has the St. Mary lot receipt and the diner tip receipt.
Perfect, can you save it with the other December stuff? I am trying to make that month look less like a crime scene.
Claro. Also Hernan and Marta sent a thank-you for the coffee sampler. They said next time no Fresno raisins, promise.
Ha, warm enough to text a thank-you, not warm enough to stop the raisin jokes.
If you do the lake run after Friday work, borrow my chains. North shore forecast still looks rude.
Yes please. I can return them before Saturday hike if I leave Incline early Sunday.
Deal. Also send me that windbreaker link you used for the Paine tabs. My old shell is giving up.
Will do. The pack list has a tiny note for gloves too, learned that one from three too many blogs.
Thursday still good? The signup clipboard at Naked Lounge fills by 7, and I refuse to miss Mira's new three-minute piece.
Yes. I can get there by 6:40 and save two chairs near the side wall.
Perfect. Also bring the tiny blue cubes for after? Bryan says the corn economy broke last time because we used lentils.
Packed them already with the score pad. No more lentil-based markets.
Made it back to Oakland. Your couch still has my hoop earring somewhere, I swear it swallowed it.
I found it under the green pillow. It can live in the little dish with your phone charger.
Perfect. Also I am replying to your 11-minute memo in pieces because the client paperwork mountain is disrespectful.
Pieces accepted. I have two more for you about Saturday's sancocho and Ben being confusing.
Mija, Mateo dice que si vas a San Jose este mes, Maya quiere que lleves los marcadores de glitter que usaste el sabado.
I can. I was looking at March 21-22 since it has been since that January weekend.
Perfecto. Priya me dijo que Luca is sleeping with the little blue truck you brought him, so prepare for requests.
Noted. I'll pack glitter markers for Maya and a truck backup for Luca.
Parcera, did you send Carmen the birthday thing or did the October photo avalanche make it weird again?
Sent it. One line, hearts, no opening any other doors.
Bien. She was always kind to you. The rest of that family can stay archived.
Exactly. Carmen gets birthdays. Nobody else gets access.
Mija, Lucía asked if you still have the little green rosary from your last visit.
Sí, lo tengo en la mesa de noche. Tell her I remember she put it in my suitcase before I flew back.
She smiled when I said June. Don’t buy yet if the fare jumps tonight.
I’ll wait. I moved another $300 into the trip bucket, so I’m at $2,050 now.
Maya wants Tía Ali drawing time Saturday. Are you around before lunch?
Could do 11:45. I’ll be back from Sofia’s thing by then if we don’t stop forever for tacos.
She says okay but only if you draw the creek rocks correctly.
Tell her I practiced during my Bidwell loop at 6:40 today. Many rocks were studied.
Your Makefile question: if the C++ extension only breaks on the cluster, check the gcc module before blaming PyTorch. Bay Area traffic has made me a compiler mystic.
It was absolutely the module. Andrés’s alignment job now runs on the HPC partition, but his Wayuunaiki batches are still weirdly slow.
Classic. Are you still doing the 4pm call with the award office tomorrow, or did they move that too?
Still 4. I need the cloud-credit numbers cleaned up first, then I can stop refreshing spreadsheets like a cursed accountant.
For Medellin prep: do you still have that yellow booklet, or should I remind you to find it before flights get real?
Found it. Passport folder has the old Kaiser 3-date series card too, weirdly organized for once.
That is extremely unlike your desktop-file behavior.
Paper health stuff gets one exception. My laptop remains a crime scene.
Tuesday leftovers became lunch. Also: the draft scene with the alien-linguistics rhythm is much tighter now.
Do you still have that tiny hallway stack of boxes from when I helped you unload the car?
Good. I was worried the Chiang echo was too loud, so I swapped in more silence and the slow light change.
Two boxes survived. I found the manila envelope from that courthouse week under the air mattress pump.
That was almost exactly two years ago, right? The Tuesday dinners started because your table was still in pieces.
Yep. Same table, still wobbling in the same little kitchen.
The slow light change works. It feels less like citation and more like your own room.
I had Turrell photos open while revising. That probably explains the room obsession.
Upper Park is clear Saturday. Want Naked Lounge after, or straight home?
Naked is good if I stick to one small coffee before 2. Last time I got cocky and paid for it with the temple vise at dinner.
One small, noted. I’ll be the annoying order monitor.
Good. I also packed the mint tin and the little night bottle in case Saturday flips into a wide-awake ceiling-stare situation.
Trail day moved to 3/28. Can you take the Friday before or are you guarding those 20 days like treasure?
Guarding them, but I can use one. I still have the separate 10-day bucket untouched, thankfully.
Responsible adult behavior, rude. Bring the new glasses if they are ready; Upper Park dust plus squinting is a bad combo.
They should be. I timed the order after the March payroll card posted, so the expensive lenses hurt less.
Parcera, I found the voice memo from July where you sounded like a tiny sad chipmunk and still tried to review slides. Criminal behavior.
That was the same PTO batch as the May ice-pack/brace era, so I had to be efficient.
Efficient is not the word. You disappeared for 5 days twice and then acted like the year was normal.
The review form asked for weeks active, and 50 looked cleaner than explaining my glamorous summer face situation.
Can you sanity check my friend's claim about LLM evals later? He keeps saying benchmark like it explains everything.
After I clear the EMNLP meta boxes and send Jamal the new abstract. My March is a spreadsheet with teeth.
You always say that and then somehow another PDF with your name at the front appears.
This year I am aiming for a sane lane: two solid ones already moving, maybe one stretch if the experiments behave.
Random question: when you started the little daily 50 mg thing, did it wreck your sleep or was that just first-month chaos?
Mostly first few weeks. Now it's more like occasional 4 a.m. ceiling-staring, annoying but not dramatic.
Got it. Also did Dr. Patel have you track anything or just vibes?
She had me jot sleep, appetite, and libido for a month. Useful, if extremely unsexy homework.
Auction page needs one image by Monday. Can I use the blue-orange one that reacts when people walk past it?
Use the still from frame 184, not the video. The motion version looks better in person.
Got it. Also your profile screenshot says 8,412 now, so I am adding the handle under the image.
Please crop the handle only, no bio. I’ll clean up the frame edges on the Cintiq after dinner.
For tomorrow: Upper Park at 8, tacos after. Also is Ben joining or is this still a no-morning-hikes musician situation?
Still no hike. He has soundcheck at noon and claims 8am is illegal on Saturdays.
Suspicious but on brand. I will reserve judgment until he survives one actual trail.
Fair. I already told him round six means he eventually has to see Bidwell in daylight.
Parcera did the money hit or are we still pretending institutions are efficient
It landed early: 2,750 after all the tiny slices. The before number was 3,915, same as the worksheet.
Good. Put some of that toward Colombia and some toward your ridiculous GPU-adjacent stress snacks.
Done. Also calendar reminder says the next one is the 31st because the 30th is not the closing day.
Parcera I just heard your voice note while chopping cilantro. Did you say Chuy again or did I imagine it? 😂
You imagined nothing. It was two blocks, I was starving, and the fridge was just eggs plus one sad lime.
Que nota. Send me the salsa photo so I can judge respectfully.
Done. Also logged it before I forgot; groceries are already doing enough damage this month.
Maya is already at the kitchen table with three sheets of paper. She says today's rule is no boring fish.
Tell her I accept the challenge. I have markers and coffee ready at 9:15.
Priya is taking Luca to the park during your call so he doesn't steal the purple marker again.
Please thank her. I need Maya's full critique panel today.
Maya wants to know why Tia Ali never sends dancing videos from that app all her friends use.
Tell Maya Tia Ali values her remaining attention span. She gets still photos and chaotic brush tests only.
Fair. Also your purple avatar pinged in that code-art room while we were drawing.
Yeah, someone asked about the shader notebook. I answered after my morning scroll window ended.
You coming down Sunday? Maya wants to wear the light-up crown thing during the 6pm game.
If I drive back after, yes. I also need your garage pump for the size 5 ball before Sofia makes me run drills again.
Pump is by the espresso junk. And bring the red-gold hoodie I left in Chico, free agency has me irrational.
Packed. I will tolerate exactly 20 minutes of roster doom before beam time.
Dad called after that council clip. He did the all-facts-first voice, but he actually stayed on the line this time.
That's new. Last year he would have changed the subject to the Kings in 90 seconds.
Progress? Also Mom told Priya some story about the winter after I was born. Apparently abuela moved in because things got rough and nobody named it.
She only told me pieces after my own stuff got loud. I'm glad she's saying it out loud now.
For Tuesday: arepas or sambar first? I need to know what to buy tomorrow.
Arepas first. I'm giving myself 550 for food out + groceries, so I need my pantry to do more work this week.
Reasonable. And you still have that 300 studio charge mid-month, right?
Yep. If PG&E stays around 70, March can still land close to 3300.
Upper Park route is muddy but doable. Need to swing back early for the hallway handoff?
Yeah, Ray and Denise said 11:30 works before their matinee. I have to show them the picky fern and Pixel's crunchy schedule.
Copy. Short loop, then Naked Lounge. Bring the boots with actual tread.
For tonight at Argus: you still doing that smoky old fashioned thing or should I just order you a glass of whatever red they have?
Smoky one if they make it with mezcal. If not, one red and then sparkling water. I already had a glass with dinner Thursday.
Copy. Also bring the little gray pouch if you want, but patio only. My neighbor gets dramatic about smells.
Probably leaving it home. Last time was after the Table Mountain day and I only needed one tiny pull.
Parcera I found the photo of you between your parents on Dec 24, holding the little candle like you were 12 again 😂
Send it but crop my face. That night already took gas, parking, and three rounds of pan de bono out of me.
Deal. Also tell Hernan from Fresno he owes us a rematch after that domino disaster at your mom's.
Parcera, Priya's little plane weekend still cracks me up. She packed like a spreadsheet and somehow forgot socks.
She landed with trail snacks, turmeric, and no socks. Honestly on brand.
Only if Marta sits between us as referee. He gets too cheerful when he wins.
And then you two went up to the mesa like normal people go to brunch. Send me the poppy pic again?
Sending. That's the one from the overlook before we gave up and went back for coffee.
Mija, your Tia sent a photo from Granada and I thought of your folder with those red walls and arches.
The 8:30 entry is still sitting in my saved tabs. I want the quiet hour before all the groups arrive.
Bueno. And Portland is the one with the painted alleys you showed me? I found the little rain jacket in the closet.
Yes, same folder. Alberta first, then the eastside walls if the drizzle behaves.
Table Mountain was worth the mud. Also did you ever decide on the fancy new trail shoes?
Waiting until the Intuit deposit actually lands. It says about $600, but I don't trust it until it hits checking.
Practical. Put some toward shoes and keep the rest for smoke-season filters?
Exactly. Not sending it to the $14k balance when the monthly is only $180 and the rate is boring.
Parcera, your voice note cut off right when you were describing the banjo guy and then suddenly you were arguing about sheep trades 😂
Parcera I’m joining from my car in 5. Don’t let Tía Elena start without me 😂
That was the whole Saturday arc: Duffy's set, tacos, then someone blocked my longest road out of pure spite.
She already said “¿y Valen?” twice. Lucía is in her blue chair waiting.
Perfect. After, let’s compare Avianca vs Copa and whether 10 days is enough this time.
Que nota. Only you make a night out sound like a field trip with math and heckling.
I did 10 after the hospital scare and it barely felt like enough, so I’m leaning 12 if the price behaves.
Accurate. My throat is scratchy and I still lost by two points.
Still on for Tuesday cooking, or is the paper eating your week?
Still on. I front-loaded today after the 9am room-312 thing, and Linh told me not to manufacture an extra meeting just to show progress.
Good. Send me the methods paragraph after dinner; I can read it once the sambar is simmering.
Perfect. I'll be at my kitchen table Wednesday until the 2pm student block, so revisions should move.
Maya wants to know if your Saturday picture has the yellow bird in it yet.
Tell her the bird is still just a pencil outline. I am going back to the Park Ave room Thursday night.
The place with the five-name key rack?
Yep. Mine, Mei, Jules, Rob, Nia. I owe the $300 before Friday too.
I am starting the sambar base at 6:35. Are you still doing plantains, or did the market fail you?
Plantains acquired. I am brushing them with chimichurri and keeping the skillet low so they don't go black before you log in.
Good. Also, can you angle the camera away from the sink this time? Last week I got 40 minutes of dish rack.
Already moved it to the bookshelf. You get stove, cutting board, and maybe one decent close-up if dinner behaves.
Maya wants to know if Tia Ali can draw the canyon trail next FaceTime, specifically the 'big quiet rocks.'
Tell her yes. Those rocks are where I stop on the long loops and just breathe for a while.
Very on brand. Also are you still doing the before-work Roots thing tomorrow or can the kids call early?
After 7:45 is safer. I will be home, calmer, and probably covered in mat lint.
Random: did Mom send you the giant panela brick too or am I the only one with a 5 lb sweet anvil now?
She sent mine with limes and a lecture. I put the mug next to the notebook so Future Me cannot pretend she forgot.
Future You sounds more organized than Present Me. Maya says your notebook needs a sticker, preferably narwhal.
Approved. Tell her today's list included 'Maya art director energy' and 'no headlines before breakfast.'
Before our Tuesday sambar attempt: did the court portal finally stop sending Daniel-linked notices to your old email?
Mostly. The 2024 file is closed; it just keeps coughing up address cleanup tasks.
Good. And Carmen replied okay after her birthday?
Sweet and brief. No mention of the October ceremony photos, thank god.
For Tuesday dinner, are we keeping it light if you have the long southbound day that weekend?
Yes. I will be in Arden-Arcade Sunday and Elena already threatened a two-plate minimum.
Then I am not assigning you dosa batter duty. Also, please pack snacks for the return drive like a functional adult.
Fine. Subaru snack bag, water, and the audiobook I keep forgetting.
Trailhead vote: Upper Park if the rain holds. Is V coming again or was last weekend her Chico dose?
Last weekend was the visit. She left a charger here so she already has an excuse for round two later.
Ha. I heard your phone playing her kitchen audio at Naked Lounge and thought she was in the room.
That was the empanada monologue. There were three parts.
Parcera, are you disappearing again in June or was Denver the only airport chaos?
June is likely, but smaller. I need to see what is left from the $2,000 line after Denver posts.
Que nota that they cover some of it. Still annoying if you have to float it first.
Exactly. I budget like $400 pain per trip and then pretend future-me is calm.
Maya wants to know why your circles go on forever. I said ask Tia Ali, I just debug payment forms.
Tell her the circles are allowed to multiply as long as they don't eat the whole page.
She also found the book you mailed. The cover with the shiny breath-looking thing?
That's the one. Keep it away from Luca's crayons; I still want it back after you finish the title story.
Mija, para el almuerzo del domingo, vas a venir sola o con Ben? Necesito saber cuánto arroz hacer.
Solo yo this time. He has a late set Saturday and I am not subjecting him to family rice math yet.
Jajaja bueno. Pero dile que cuide la garganta si canta tan tarde.
